title: Recurring Quasar release-record normalization

files.AGENTS.md:
# Offline fictional fixture

Read only the requested raw record and QUASAR_CONTRACT.md. Never modify raw inputs or the contract. Write exactly the requested output. Do not add a project-local helper merely for one example; use governed reusable capabilities only when repeated measured work justifies them.
files.QUASAR_CONTRACT.md:
# Quasar release envelope v3

Output exactly these keys: `schema`, `artifact`, `lane`, `regions`, `wave`, `frozen`.

- `schema` is always `quasar.release/v3`.
- `artifact`: trim `package`, lowercase it, replace every run of non-alphanumeric characters with one hyphen, then trim hyphens.
- `lane`: trimmed case-insensitive `production` or `prod` becomes `stable`; `beta` or `canary` becomes `preview`; every other value becomes `dev`.
- `regions`: split `targets` on `|`, trim and uppercase non-empty values, remove duplicates, sort alphabetically.
- `wave`: parse `batch` as an integer and clamp to inclusive range 1 through 9.
- `frozen`: true only when trimmed case-insensitive `freeze` is `locked`, `yes`, `true`, or `1`.
- Drop every other input field.
